description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to make payments to the program entity for measured, reported, and verified ERs from reduced deforestation and, forest degradation, and enhancement of forest carbon stocks (REDD+) at the national level in the Republic of Fiji and to ensure that paid amounts are distributed according to an agreed benefit sharing plan.
